passages.text: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary. But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
passages.note: Losing early passion despite faithful effort

passages.text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
passages.note: Fear of coming hardship, staying faithful

passages.text: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked; I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
passages.note: Complacency in wealth, blindness to inner poverty

passages.text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
passages.note: Loneliness, openness to the divine, invitation
